name: Android Vigilante (CR 6)
body:
ANDROID VIGILANTE
CR 6

XP 2,400
Male android vigilante 7
NG/N Medium humanoid (android)
Init +5; Senses darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision; Perception –1

DEFENSE

AC 16, touch 11, flat-footed 15 (+5 armor, +1 Dex)
hp 56 (7d8+21)
Fort +5, Ref +7, Will +8
Defensive Abilities constructed, evasion, unshakable (+7); Immune disease, emotion-based effects, exhaustion, fatigue, fear, sleep

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee +1 longsword +12/+7 (1d8+5)
Special Attacks nanite surge, startling appearance

STATISTICS

Str 16, Dex 12, Con 14, Int 15, Wis 8, Cha 10
Base Atk +7; CMB +10; CMD 22
Feats Improved Initiative, Iron Will, Power Attack B, Toughness, Weapon Focus (longsword)
Skills Acrobatics +10, Bluff +10, Craft (mechanical) +12, Disguise +10 (+30 when appearing as part of polite society in his social identity), Knowledge (engineering) +12, Knowledge (local) +12, Stealth +10
Languages +1 additional, Common, +1 additional
SQ dual identity, emotionless, seamless guise, social talents (gossip collector, great renown, renown, safe house), vigilante specialization (avenger), vigilante talents (evasive, shield of blades, sure-footed)
Combat Gear potion of cure light wounds; Other Gear +1 chain shirt, +1 longsword, cloak of resistance +1, gray access card, 3 silverdisks (worth 30 gp total; Technology Guide 39), 5 gp
